title: Sister Aimee and the Birth of the Megachurch

sentences.en: In the artsy neighborhood of Echo Park in Los Angeles, right across the street from Echo Park Lake,
sentences.zh: 在洛杉矶充满艺术气息的艾科公园社区，就在艾科公园湖的街对面，

sentences.en: you'll find a building that begs to be noticed.
sentences.zh: 你会发现一栋让人忍不住行注目礼的建筑。

sentences.en: It sits against the backdrop of coffee shops, tattoo parlors, and tattoo parlor slash coffee shops.
sentences.zh: 它的背景是咖啡馆、纹身店，以及兼营咖啡馆的纹身店。

sentences.en: It's a colossal white structure that looks like an arena laced with archways.
sentences.zh: 这是一座巨大的白色建筑，看起来就像一座环绕着拱门的竞技场。

sentences.en: Its defining feature is an enormous concrete dome perched overhead.
sentences.zh: 它最标志性的特征是头顶上方悬着一个巨大的混凝土穹顶。

sentences.en: The building itself is a blend of classical and modern design elements
sentences.zh: 这座建筑本身融合了古典与现代的设计元素，

sentences.en: and has been described as, quote, half Roman Colosseum, half Parisian Opera House.
sentences.zh: 曾被人形容为——引述一下——“一半是罗马斗兽场，一半是巴黎歌剧院”。

sentences.en: I mean, some people have described it that way.
sentences.zh: 我是说，确实有人这么形容过它。

sentences.en: But if you ask me, I think it looks more like a concrete flying saucer landed on top of the Rose Bowl Stadium.
sentences.zh: 但如果你问我，我觉得它看起来更像是有一个混凝土飞碟降落在玫瑰碗体育场的顶部。

sentences.en: That's reporter, actor, and frequent contributor, Gillian Jacobs.
sentences.zh: 这位是记者、演员兼常驻嘉宾吉莉安·雅各布斯。

sentences.en: One of my personal nerdier hobbies is driving around Los Angeles and looking up the history of buildings.
sentences.zh: 我个人比较偏门的一个爱好就是开车兜风，顺便查查洛杉矶各种建筑的历史。

sentences.en: It's what I do to relax.
So, of course, the first time I went to Echo Park Lake, I homed in on that building across the street.
sentences.zh: 所以，理所当然地，我第一次去艾科公园湖时，我的目光一下子就锁定街对面的那栋建筑。

sentences.en: I had to know what it was.
sentences.zh: 我非得搞清楚那是什么不可。

sentences.en: And luckily for me, there are tours available.
sentences.zh: 对我来说幸运的是，那里现在开放参观。

sentences.en: The dome was also the largest freestanding dome of that size and shape, at least in the Northern Hemisphere, if not the world at the time.
sentences.zh: 在当时，这个穹顶也是北半球乃至全世界同等尺寸和形状中最大的无支撑穹顶。

sentences.en: Turns out this place is a Pentecostal church called the Angelus Temple.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，这个地方是一座名为“安琪儿圣殿”的五旬节派教堂。

sentences.en: Dan Scott is head docent of the temple's Heritage Museum.
sentences.zh: 丹·斯科特是该圣殿历史博物馆的首席讲解员。
它的建造方式也很独特。

sentences.en: So that's why it's never burned down all these years.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是为什么这些年来它从来没有被烧毁过。

sentences.en: The temple was designed by the church's founder, Sister Amy Semple McPherson.
sentences.zh: 这座圣殿由教堂的创始人艾米·森普尔·麦克弗森修女设计。

sentences.en: Her voice was actually playing through the museum speakers throughout the tour.
sentences.zh: 在参观过程中，博物馆的扬声器里其实一直在播放她的声音。

sentences.en: What you hear in the background are live church services that were broadcast live from the temple.
sentences.zh: 你在背景中听到的，是当年直接从圣殿现场直播的礼拜实况。

sentences.en: I'm going to turn her off for a while.
sentences.zh: 我打算先把她关一会儿。

sentences.en: Sometimes I feel like I'm competing with her.
sentences.zh: 有时我觉得自己就像在跟她竞争一样。

sentences.en: As it happens, the Angelus Temple isn't just an architectural anomaly in Echo Park.
sentences.zh: 碰巧的是，安琪儿圣殿不仅是艾科公园的一个建筑异类，

sentences.en: It's regarded as the very first megachurch ever built in the United States.
sentences.zh: 它还被认为是美国历史上建造的第一座巨型教堂。

sentences.en: The temple was opened in 1923, which predates the modern megachurch movement by about a half a century.
sentences.zh: 该圣殿于1923年开放，比现代巨型教堂运动早了大约半个世纪。

sentences.en: Today, when millions of Americans enter contemporary megachurches with all of their accompanying theatrical accoutrements,
sentences.zh: 今天，当数以百万计的美国人带着各种伴随而来的戏剧化行头走进当代巨型教堂时，

sentences.en: they unknowingly enter spaces pioneered by Amy Semple McPherson.
sentences.zh: 他们不知不觉地步入了由艾米·森普尔·麦克弗森开创的空间。

sentences.en: So much about what you see in megachurches today and, you know, Christian broadcasting and entertainment, Christian fiction,
sentences.zh: 你在今天的巨型教堂里看到的大部分东西，还有基督教广播、娱乐、基督教小说，

sentences.en: all of that is, you know, these things that she started.
sentences.zh: 所有这些，你知道的，都是她当年开创的。

sentences.en: This is Claire Hoffman, author of Sister Sinner,
sentences.zh: 这位是克莱尔·霍夫曼，《罪人修女：艾米·森普尔·麦克弗森的奇迹人生与神秘失踪》一书的作者。

sentences.en: The Miraculous Life and Mysterious Disappearance of Amy Semple McPherson.
sentences.zh: 正如你从克莱尔的书名中想象的那样，

sentences.en: As you can imagine from the title of Claire's book,
sentences.zh: 麦克弗森的故事远不止是一个传道人那么简单。

sentences.en: there's a lot more to McPherson's story than just being a preacher.
sentences.zh: 麦克弗森革新了礼拜形式，在当时可以说是美国最著名的女性之一。

sentences.en: McPherson transformed worship and at one point was arguably one of the most famous women in America.
sentences.zh: 她建造了全国最大的教堂之一，每周吸引成千上万的人慕名而来。

sentences.en: She built one of the largest churches in the country and filled it with thousands of people a week.
sentences.zh: 她还掀起了20世纪初最耸人听闻的公众丑闻之一。

sentences.en: She also stirred up one of the most salacious public dramas of the early 20th century.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她做出的一些决定和犯下的错误本身就相当受人质疑。

sentences.en: You know, she was making some decisions and mistakes that were pretty questionable themselves.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个非常复杂的人，她既不可思议又充满力量，同时也做出了一些非常离奇的选择。

sentences.en: And so here's a really complicated person who was incredible and powerful and also made some really weird choices.
sentences.zh: 在她的名字加上“森普尔”和“麦克弗森”之前，艾米修女于1890年出生，原名艾米·肯尼迪。

sentences.en: Before she added the Semple and McPherson, Sister Amy was born Amy Kennedy in 1890.
sentences.zh: 这里是她讲述自己在加拿大农村成长经历的录音。

sentences.en: Here she is talking about growing up in rural Canada.
sentences.zh: 那是安大略省一个很远的加拿大农场，作为农场主的女儿，我出生并在那里长大。

sentences.en: It was some distance away on a Canadian farm in Ontario that I was born and brought up as a farmer's daughter.
sentences.zh: 我是农场里唯一的男孩，也是农场里唯一的女孩。

sentences.en: I was the only boy on the farm, the only girl on the farm.
sentences.zh: 就连她自己也承认，艾米在学生时代是个不折不扣的优等生。

sentences.en: By even her own account, Amy was an overachiever during her schoolgirl years.
sentences.zh: 在她的著作中，她将自己描述为班上的尖子生、天生的领袖、辩论家、朗诵家，并且总是寻找表现的机会。

sentences.en: In her own writings, she describes herself as top of her class, a natural leader, debater, elocutionist, and always looking for an opportunity to perform.
sentences.zh: 艾米出生在一个宗教家庭。

sentences.en: Amy came from a religious family.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲米妮是救世军的虔诚成员。

sentences.en: Her mother, Minnie, was a devout member of the Salvation Army.
sentences.zh: 艾米在17岁时经历了自己的神圣体验。

sentences.en: And Amy had her own divine experience when she was 17 years old.
sentences.zh: 她遇到了一个超级性感的传道人罗伯特·森普尔，他是五旬节派的早期皈依者。

sentences.en: She met this super hot preacher named Robert Semple, who was an early convert of Pentecostalism.
sentences.zh: 艾米深深地爱上了这个超级性感的传道人罗伯特·森普尔，也爱上了五旬节运动。

sentences.en: Amy fell deeply in love with the super hot preacher Robert Semple and with Pentecostalism.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪初，五旬节派是一项新兴的新教宗教运动，开始在美国各地传播。

sentences.en: In the early 20th century, Pentecostalism was a new Protestant religious movement that was beginning to spread across the U.S.
sentences.zh: 当时，它在主流基督教中被视为边缘派系，主要是因为它包含更多戏剧化的元素。

sentences.en: At the time, it was viewed as fringe within mainline Christianity, mostly because of its more dramatic elements.
sentences.zh: 比如信仰治愈和说方言。

sentences.en: Faith healing and the speaking in tongues.
sentences.zh: 这位是威廉·舒尔茨，芝加哥大学神学院美国宗教专业助理教授。

sentences.en: This is William Schultz, assistant professor of American religions at the University of Chicago Divinity School.
sentences.zh: 在这些具体表现的背后，是五旬节派的核心理念，即每个人都需要被圣灵充满。

sentences.en: In back of those specific things is the general idea of Pentecostalism, which is that everyone needs an infilling of the Holy Spirit.
sentences.zh: 你需要向这种超越你自身的力量——圣灵——敞开心扉，让它涌入并改变你，让你成为一个全新的人。

sentences.en: You need to open yourself up to this force beyond you, the Holy Spirit, which will flow into you and transform you, make you an entirely new person.
sentences.zh: 当时五旬节派遭到许多人的看不起。

sentences.en: Pentecostalism was looked down upon by many at the time.
sentences.zh: 信徒们甚至被贬称为“圣洁滚球者”，因为当圣灵充满发生时，

sentences.en: Followers were even disparagingly called holy rollers because when that infilling of the Holy Spirit took place,
sentences.zh: 一些信徒会在礼拜期间无法控制地在地上打滚。

sentences.en: some worshipers would uncontrollably roll on the ground during services.
sentences.zh: 但艾米深深地被这种崇拜形式所打动。

sentences.en: But Amy was deeply moved by this form of worship.
sentences.zh: 她皈依了五旬节派，不久她和罗伯特·森普尔就结了婚并期待着孩子的降生。

sentences.en: She converted to Pentecostalism, and soon she and Robert Semple were married and expecting a child.
sentences.zh: 他们一起踏上了前往中国的福音巡回之旅，希望能将五旬节运动传播到世界的另一端。

sentences.en: Together, they embarked on an evangelical tour to China, hoping to spread Pentecostalism to the other side of the world.
sentences.zh: 五旬节运动成为了她余生中极其重要的一部分。

sentences.en: Pentecostalism would become a huge part of the rest of her life.

sentences.zh: 在他们抵达中国后不到一个月就去世了。

sentences.en: He died within a month of them arriving in China.
sentences.zh: 回到美国几年后，艾米再次结婚，改名为艾米·森普尔·麦克弗森。

sentences.en: Amy married again a couple of years after returning to the United States, becoming Amy Semple McPherson.
sentences.zh: 但她很快意识到这第二段婚姻并不是她的归宿。

sentences.en: But she quickly realized that this second marriage wasn't her path.
sentences.zh: 她陷入了一场严重打击她身心健康的抑郁症，甚至严重到需要住院治疗。

sentences.en: She fell into a depression that severely impacted her mental and physical health to the point that she was hospitalized.
sentences.zh: 正是在这段创伤期的中间，她顿悟了。

sentences.en: And in the midst of this traumatic period, she had an epiphany.
sentences.zh: 她说耶稣来到她面前对她说，你知道的，你必须把福音传下去，这就是你的工作。

sentences.en: She says that Jesus came to her and said, you know, you have to spread the word, and this is your job.
sentences.zh: 于是麦克弗森回应了召唤。
她离开第二任丈夫，把孩子和妈妈塞进车里，

sentences.en: She left husband number two, packed her kids and her mom into her car,
sentences.zh: 作为一名巡回传道人开始了新的人生，这条路被称为“木屑小径”。

sentences.en: and began a new life as a traveling preacher on what was called the Sawdust Trail.
sentences.zh: 木屑小径并不是一条有着固定路线的字面意义上的小径。

sentences.en: The Sawdust Trail wasn't a literal trail with a set path.
sentences.zh: 相反，四处游走的牧师们——几乎全都是男性——

sentences.en: Rather, roving pastors, who were almost exclusively men,
sentences.zh: 会在各个城市和小镇之间奔波，举办喧闹的奋兴布道会。

sentences.en: would travel from city to city and town to town, holding boisterous revival meetings.
sentences.zh: 所以，在木屑小径上，这是一个竞争非常激烈的市场。

sentences.en: So, with the Sawdust Trail, it's a really competitive marketplace.
sentences.zh: 这里有成百上千甚至上万名四处奔走的复兴主义者。

sentences.en: There are hundreds, thousands of itinerant revivalists.
sentences.zh: 因此你时刻都处于与其他人竞争的状态中。

sentences.en: And so you are in a constant state of competition with other people.
sentences.zh: 这个巡回圈子里的许多其他传道人传教时都带有某种充满雄性激素的、具有侵略性的风格。

sentences.en: Many of these other preachers on the circuit evangelized in a sort of testosterone-laden, aggressive style.
sentences.zh: 美国必须被带到上帝的澡堂里，用水龙头好好冲洗一番。

sentences.en: America needs to be taken down to God's bathhouse, and the hose turned on her.
sentences.zh: 我想在这个观众席中征集一个誓言，加入我的承诺，

sentences.en: And I want to take a pledge in this audience to join me in a pledge
sentences.zh: 即你们绝不罢休，直到这个古老的、痛恨上帝的、痛恨基督的、

sentences.en: that you will never rest until this old God-hating, Christ-hating,
sentences.zh: 浸泡在威士忌里的、破坏安息日的、亵渎神明的、异教徒的、走私私酒的旧世界，

sentences.en: whiskey-soaked, Sabbath-breaking, blaspheming, infidel, bootlegging old world
sentences.zh: 被爱之金链紧紧束缚在耶稣基督的十字架上。

sentences.en: is bound to the cross of Jesus Christ by the golden chains of love.
sentences.zh: 艾米修女的信息完全不是那样的。

sentences.en: Sister Amy's message was nothing like that.
sentences.zh: 她具备所有的个人魅力和戏剧张力，但传递的信息却更加温和。

sentences.en: She had all of the charisma and theatricality, but a gentler message.
sentences.zh: 艾米包装了一种——找不到更好的词来形容了——非常家庭化的风格，

sentences.en: Amy packages, for lack of a better word, a really domestic style,
sentences.zh: 你在木屑小径上的很多人身上是看不到这一点的。

sentences.en: which you don't see among many people on the Sawdust Trail.
sentences.zh: 每天更深地去爱某个人。

sentences.en: To love someone more dearly every day.
sentences.zh: 帮助迷途的孩子找到回家的路。

sentences.en: To help a wandering child to find his way.
sentences.zh: 在崇高的十字架上沉思、祈祷，并在夜幕降临时微笑。

sentences.en: To ponder on a noble cross and pray and smile when evening falls.

sentences.zh: 她强调了自己与大众的联系。
这种朴实的乡村女性、挤奶女工的形象，

sentences.en: This image of a simple country person, a milkmaid,
sentences.zh: 被这种神圣的力量所注入。

sentences.en: who has been infused with this divine power.
sentences.zh: 这或许正是让艾米在竞争激烈的宗教市场中脱颖而出的秘诀所在。

sentences.en: And this might be the thing which allows Amy to rise out of this very competitive religious marketplace.
sentences.zh: 麦克弗森凭直觉就知道如何触及人心，

sentences.en: McPherson intuitively knew how to reach people
sentences.zh: 并且利用了她所能掌握的任何大众传媒工具。

sentences.en: and used whatever mass media tools were at her disposal.
sentences.zh: 起初她使用扩音器，接着创办了一本月刊。

sentences.en: At first, she used a megaphone and then started a monthly magazine.
sentences.zh: 随着她的成功，她不仅是在推广自己的传道事工，

sentences.en: With her success, she wasn't just popularizing her ministry.
sentences.zh: 她更是在推广五旬节运动本身。
美国五旬节运动的奠基领袖之一是一位名叫威廉·西摩的黑人牧师。

sentences.en: One of the foundational leaders of American Pentecostalism was a black pastor named William Seymour.
sentences.zh: 西摩希望创建一个跨种族的教堂，让任何种族的信徒都能一起做礼拜。

sentences.en: Seymour wanted to create an interracial church where congregants of any race could worship together.
sentences.zh: 但到了1914年，种族隔离导致该教派分裂。

sentences.en: But by 1914, segregation caused the denomination to split.
sentences.zh: 当时有白人五旬节运动和非裔美国人五旬节运动，它们都相当边缘化。

sentences.en: There's the sort of the white Pentecostal movement and the African American, and they're both pretty fringy.
sentences.zh: 艾米·森普尔·麦克弗森正是在这次分裂前后开始传道，

sentences.en: Amy Semple McPherson began ministering around the time of this split
sentences.zh: 并将主要由白人组成的五旬节运动推广到大众之中。

sentences.en: and popularized the predominantly white version of Pentecostalism to the masses.
sentences.zh: 我曾把她比作埃尔维斯，既有正面也有负面的相似之处。

sentences.en: I have compared her both sort of positively and negatively to Elvis.
sentences.zh: 她将之变成了一场奇观。
她让它变得更容易被人接受。
就像大众化所做的一切一样，就像猫王对布鲁斯音乐做的那样，对吧？

sentences.en: So all the things that like kind of popularizing does in the way that Elvis did with the blues, right?
sentences.zh: 所以这就好比，你知道的，起源完全在别处，但她充当了这样一座桥梁。

sentences.en: So it's like, you know, the origins are very much elsewhere, but she was sort of this bridge.
sentences.zh: 1918年，在木屑小径上打拼了三年并小有名气之后，

sentences.en: In 1918, after three years of making a name for herself on the Sawdust Trail,
sentences.zh: 麦克弗森的名气越来越大，但无休止的奔波开始让她感到疲惫。

sentences.en: McPherson's profile had grown, but the endless traveling was beginning to wear on her.
sentences.zh: 在她的女儿差点死于1918年的流感之后，

sentences.en: After her daughter nearly died from the 1918 flu,
sentences.zh: 麦克弗森声称自己受到上帝的召唤，要前往西部建立一座永久的教堂，

sentences.en: McPherson claimed that she was called by God to head west and build a permanent church,
sentences.zh: 而那座教堂将建在洛杉矶。

sentences.en: and that church would be in Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 这个决定最终不仅在整个城市激起涟漪，还将影响美国基督教的未来。

sentences.en: It was a decision that ultimately would reverberate not just through the city,
sentences.zh: 在许多方面，洛杉矶与艾米·森普尔·麦克弗森堪称绝配。

sentences.en: but the future of American Christianity.
sentences.zh: 首先，这座城市在五旬节运动的兴起中扮演了关键角色，

sentences.en: Los Angeles, in many ways, was the perfect fit for Amy Semple McPherson.
sentences.zh: 因为威廉·西摩的复兴运动就在这里。

sentences.en: For one, the city was playing a pivotal role in the rise of Pentecostalism
because it's where William Seymour's revival was located.
sentences.zh: 是一个虽小但飞速发展的城市，
挤满了来自中西部和南部的基督教移居者。

sentences.en: in 1918 was a small but rapidly growing city
sentences.zh: 这是一个渴望精神指引的地方。

sentences.en: packed with Christian migrants from the Midwest and South.
